## Librerías

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

theme_set(theme_light() +
            theme(legend.position = "bottom",
                  plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
                  plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
                  axis.ticks = element_blank()))
```

## Funciones

```{r}
histogram_matrix <- function(df, var_num){
  lista_plots <- list()
  for(i in 1:length(var_num)){
    lista_plots[[i]] <- dataset_train |> 
      ggplot(aes(!!sym(var_num[i]))) + 
      geom_histogram(fill = "steelblue") +
      labs(title = var_num[i]) +
      theme(axis.title.x = element_blank())
  }
  
  salida <- patchwork::wrap_plots(lista_plots)
  
  return(salida)
}
```


## Cargando Datos

```{r}
dataset_train <- read_csv(here::here("playground-series-s6e4/01-data", "train.csv")) |>
  select(-id)
head(dataset_train)
```

## Meta - Análisis

```{r}
df_status_train <- funModeling::df_status(dataset_train, print_results = FALSE)
df_status_train
```

- En el primer análisis no tenemos datos nulos ni ceros en las variables.
- 8 variables categóricas
- 11 variables numéricas
- 1 target

## Análisis de Datos

```{r}
var_cat <- df_status_train |>
  filter(type == "character" & variable != "Irrigation_Need") |>
  pull(variable)

var_num <- df_status_train |>
  filter(type != "character") |>
  pull(variable)

target <- "Irrigation_Need"
```

### Univariado

#### Variable Numéricas

```{r}
histogram_matrix(dataset_train, var_num) +
```
